title: CZK, a novel alkaloid derivative from Clausena lansium, alleviates ischemic stroke injury through Nrf2-mediated antioxidant effects.
authors: Chen, Haodong; Liu, Yangbo; Feng, Juling; Wang, Hongyun; Yang, Yantao; Ai, Qidi; Zhang, Zhao; Chu, Shifeng; Chen, Naihong
one_liner_zh: 该文研究天然生物碱衍生物CZK通过Nrf2抗氧化通路缓解缺血性脑卒中损伤，仅涉及小分子与Nrf2蛋白的分子对接，无蛋白质-DNA互作体系，亦无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Anti-oxidant stress is a potential strategy for the treatment of ischemic stroke. Here, we found a novel free radical scavenger termed as CZK, which is derived from alkaloids contained in Clausena lansium. In this study, we first compared cytotoxicity and biological activity between CZK and its parent's compound Claulansine F. It was found that CZK had lower cytotoxicity and improved anti-oxygen-glucose deprivation/reoxygenation (OGD/R) injury than its parent's compound. Free radical scavenging test showed that CZK had a strong inhibitory effect on hydroxyl free radicals with the IC(50) of 77.08 nM. Intravenous injection of CZK (50 mg/kg) significantly alleviated ischemia-reperfusion injury, manifested by reduced neuronal damage and decreased oxidative stress. Consistent with the findings, the activities of superoxide dismutase (SOD) and reduced glutathione (GSH) were increased. Molecular docking predicted that CZK might be combined with nuclear factor erythroid 2-related factor 2 (Nrf2) complex. Our results also confirmed that CZK upregulated the contents of Nrf2 and its target gene products Heme Oxygenase-1 (HO-1), and NAD(P)H: Quinone Oxidoreductase 1 (NQO1). In conclusion, CZK had a potential therapeutic effect for ischemic stroke by activating Nrf2-mediated antioxidant system.
abstract_zh: 抗氧化应激是治疗缺血性卒中的潜在策略。在此，我们发现了一种新型自由基清除剂，命名为CZK，其来源于黄皮（Clausena lansium）中所含的生物碱。在本研究中，我们首先比较了CZK与其母体化合物Clausanine F之间的细胞毒性和生物活性。结果发现，CZK具有较低的细胞毒性，并且比其母体化合物更能改善氧糖剥夺/再灌注（OGD/R）损伤。自由基清除试验显示，CZK对羟基自由基具有强抑制作用，其IC(50)为77.08 nM。静脉注射CZK（50 mg/kg）显著减轻了缺血再灌注损伤，表现为神经元损伤减少和氧化应激降低。与这些发现一致，超氧化物歧化酶（SOD）和还原型谷胱甘肽（GSH）的活性增加。分子对接预测CZK可能与核因子E2相关因子2（Nrf2）复合物结合。我们的结果也证实，CZK上调了Nrf2及其靶基因产物血红素加氧酶-1（HO-1）和NAD(P)H：醌氧化还原酶1（NQO1）的含量。总之，CZK通过激活Nrf2介导的抗氧化系统，对缺血性卒中具有潜在的治疗效果。
